name: Composal
long_description: Composal gives engineers always-on agents that work in the cloud, each with its own computer, Slack handle and memory. An engineer gives one a standing order, like “watch Sentry, fix new errors, get the fix reviewed and ship it,” and it keeps going after the laptop closes. Our QA agents test every pull request by using the app like a real user, and have found over 1,500 bugs in customers’ apps since mid-October.
one_liner: Always-on agents that keep working after engineers log off
